seoTitle: Get a Business Email on GoDaddy with Your Domain
metaDescription: Set up a branded business email like yourname@yourdomain.com through GoDaddy, with Google Workspace integration and MX record configuration explained.
intro: A branded email address like yourname@yourdomain.com builds trust for freelancers, startups, and small businesses in a way a generic email address can't. This guide covers purchasing an email plan through GoDaddy, connecting it to Gmail via Google Workspace, and getting the MX records configured correctly.

steps.heading: Purchase or access an email plan
steps.body: Choose an email plan from GoDaddy, whether that's a basic email forwarding option or full Google Workspace integration.

steps.heading: Set up email forwarding or Google Workspace
steps.body: Decide between simple forwarding to an existing inbox or a full Gmail-based business email through Google Workspace.

steps.heading: Verify your domain with Google
steps.body: Complete Google's domain verification process, which confirms you own the domain before Workspace can be fully activated.

steps.heading: Configure MX records in GoDaddy DNS
steps.body: Update the MX records in your GoDaddy DNS settings so email routes correctly to your new Google Workspace inbox.

steps.heading: Access your new business Gmail
steps.body: Once configured, log in to your professional Gmail account tied to your domain to start sending and receiving branded email.

faq.question: Do I need Google Workspace for a business email, or can I just forward it?
faq.answer: Both are options — forwarding is simpler but limited, while Google Workspace gives you a full Gmail-based inbox tied to your domain.

faq.question: Why do I need to verify my domain with Google?
faq.answer: Verification proves you own the domain, which is required before Google will activate Workspace email for that address.

faq.question: What are MX records for?
faq.answer: MX records tell the internet where to route incoming email for your domain, which is essential for your business email to actually receive messages.

faq.question: Can I use my business email on my phone?
faq.answer: Yes, once set up through Google Workspace, you can access your business Gmail account on mobile just like any other Gmail account.
